vision: Core Flowtron assets: project-agnostic docs/templates, versioned schema, storage format discovery, compatibility docs, and diagrams.

current_state.docs: Project-specific guidance exists in FinTown; no standalone set
current_state.schema: JSON-based templates exist without formal versioning

target_state.docs: Project-agnostic docs + templates in _projects/flowtron/docs and templates/
target_state.schema: Versioned v1 with migration notes; discovery for JSON vs YAML vs DB
target_state.ui: Read-only UI MVP tracked separately in frontend plan

tasks.title: Bootstrap Flowtron: structure, docs, templates
tasks.goal: Create project-agnostic scaffolding (docs + templates) so Flowtron can be reused across repos.
steps: Create _projects/flowtron structure with docs/ and templates/ subfolders
Add Flowtron README with vision, layout, and quick start
Add docs: README, compatibility.md, prompt-template.md
Add templates: plan-template.json, plan-sub-template.json, tasknote-template.json with brief embedded AI guidance
Ensure each file includes schema_version and lightweight guidance where useful
acceptance_criteria: All files exist and are well-formed JSON/Markdown
Templates are minimal yet self-explanatory without redundancy
No changes made to FinTown-specific TaskNote instructions

tasks.title: Vision document (VISION.md)
tasks.goal: Capture first-principles vision, domain model, workflow, storage strategy, and next steps.
steps: Draft vision, principles, model, and workflow loop
Compare storage options; recommend SQL + JSON exchange
Define next steps and migration plan
acceptance_criteria: Mentions SQL as source of truth and AI JSON exchange format

tasks.title: Storage architecture decision (SQL schema + adapter plan)
tasks.goal: Design a minimal SQL schema (SQLite/Postgres) and a storage adapter with import/export from current JSON.
steps: Propose SQL schema for plans, tasks, dependencies, tasknotes, phases, steps
Draft adapter interface and CLI import/export commands
Outline migration from JSON-only to hybrid DB + JSON exchange
acceptance_criteria: Schema draft and adapter plan added to docs

tasks.title: Schema v1 + versioning and migration notes
tasks.goal: Introduce schema_version, document fields, and establish a simple migrations/CHANGELOG for future evolution.
steps: Define required and optional fields for plan and tasknote templates (v1)
Add schema_version: '1.0.0' to templates
Create docs/migrations/CHANGELOG.md to log schema changes and migration guidance

tasks.title: Discovery: Data format and storage strategy (JSON vs YAML vs PostgreSQL)
tasks.goal: Evaluate formats and storage for scalability, validation, and AI usability; recommend a path and next steps.
steps: Compare JSON and YAML for human/AI usability, schema validation, and tooling
Assess PostgreSQL-backed plans/tasknotes for querying, collaboration, and migrations
Document pros/cons, migration implications, and CI/CD considerations (incl. GitHub Actions)
Publish docs/storage-evaluation.md with a recommendation and phased plan
acceptance_criteria: docs/storage-evaluation.md exists with a clear recommendation
Backlog items created for the non-chosen options if warranted

tasks.title: Validator: integrate workflow validation into CLI and app
tasks.goal: Port and adapt validation (structure, TaskNote shape, plan integration) as a core CLI command and plan for UI integration.
steps: Add CLI command to validate structure, TaskNote JSON, and plan membership
Wire npm script and document in docs
Backlog UI integration (surface validation in future app)
Create sample TaskNote to test validation
acceptance_criteria: npm run flowtron:validate exits 0 on green and 1 on violations
Reports missing archive subfolders, invalid TaskNotes, and tasks missing from plans
Docs reference the command from setup/README

tasks.title: Compatibility mapping (FinTown → Flowtron)
tasks.goal: Document mapping from current FinTown TaskNotes/plans to Flowtron generic schema and identify adapters needed.
steps: Draft docs/compatibility.md mapping fields and semantics
List adapter scripts as backlog items (no code yet)
Call out any gaps or irreversible differences
acceptance_criteria: compatibility.md covers core entities (plan, tasknote, steps, phases)
Clear guidance on ingesting legacy notes without modifying FinTown

tasks.title: Diagrams: workflow and data model
tasks.goal: Provide Mermaid diagrams in docs to visualize phases, steps, and data model relationships.
steps: Add docs/diagrams/ with workflow and data model diagrams
Reference diagrams from docs/README.md
acceptance_criteria: Mermaid diagrams render correctly in Markdown previews
